note: Mann-Whitney U / Kruskal-Wallis recomputed on ctrl_baseline TD values after removing the 3x export duplication documented in README.md (results_v3/ctrl_baseline.json contains 150 rows per level = 50 unique code samples exported 3 times each; this file uses the deduplicated 50-per-level set so that U-test independence assumptions hold). TD values here are the OLD-vocabulary td field from results_v3/ctrl_baseline.json (see README note on td field versioning); this file only corrects the sample-independence issue in the significance test, it does not change which TD numbers are reported in the paper.
dedup_method: grouped by 'code' field per level, kept first occurrence, verified all 3 duplicates per code had identical td/pred values before dropping

original_non_independent_result_for_refe.issue: U computed on 150 rows/level (50 unique x 3 duplicated exports), exceeding the n=50 independent-sample theoretical max of 2500; p-values and effect sizes from this run should not be used for significance claims

conclusion: Direction and significance of all three pairwise comparisons are unchanged after deduplication (all remain significant after Bonferroni correction). The layer-wise TD separation reported in the paper is robust to this correction.
